URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/netanyahu-to-meet-trump-at-white-house-next-week-amid-iran-war-escalation
(WebFetch; Al Jazeera, filed 24 July 2026)

- Netanyahu to meet Trump at the White House on Tuesday; his seventh White House visit during Trump's second term, "far outpacing any other world leader."
- Visit coincides with Netanyahu's attendance at Senator Lindsey Graham's funeral.
- Trump on the ICC warrant: "Benjamin Netanyahu will not be arrested, in any way, shape, or form, while in the United States of America."
- Gaza: an estimated 1.4 million people (67% of Gaza's population) suffering "crisis or worse levels of acute food insecurity"; at least 73,311 Palestinians killed total, 1,185 since the October ceasefire began.
